name: Theme Reveal from the Click Point
note: The theme flips inside a view transition with both snapshots held still, and the Web Animations API grows a clip-path circle on ::view-transition-new from the exact click point (sized to the farthest corner) while the old snapshot dims. It runs scoped to the component through element.startViewTransition where available, document-level otherwise.

note: The current icon, temperature and range bar keep one view-transition-name across Now, Hourly and 5-day, so they spring between a hero, a column and a table row; everything else enters through ::view-transition-new(...):only-child with per-item delays.

name: Page-Turn Recipe Booklet
note: Page snapshots are pinned opaque and the Web Animations API turns the old sheet about its spine with perspective rotateY, z-index and a darkening brightness() filter, or swings the new one down when going back; the progress dots morph as named groups.

name: Contact Sheet to Loupe
note: Each frame's window is a named group with overflow: clip and object-fit: cover snapshots, so a square-cropped thumbnail un-crops to its full 3:2 frame and closing lands on whichever frame is showing; in the loupe, frames slide through their own clipped groups.
